tweets: Suśruta of Kāśī, father of surgery: his Suśruta Saṃhitā, compiled roughly 2,500 years ago, describes over 300 procedures — among them cataract couching with a curved needle, and rhinoplasty, rebuilding a lost nose from a flap of cheek skin.
